unmodeled.text: Solo Boost can be used. and Solo Boost activates when the Solo Boost Gauge is at max. The gauge is filled when you KO enemies, attack enemies with Normal Attacks, continually recover your team's Treasure Gauge, continually lower the enemy's Treasure Gauge, or respawn. Solo Boost is removed after a certain period of time or when you are KO'd.

While Solo Boost is active, Trait KO Possible icon appears on enemies, and Skill 2's last hit nullifies an enemy's Traits and KOs them instead of dealing damage (excludes invincibility). Dodge changes into an ability that allows you to attack (200 Power) while moving at long range. and 1 HP will be left even if KO'd. and Boost the cooldown reduction speed of skills and dodge by 200%.
When using a skill: Class changes to Attacker(s).
After holding down the normal attack button during the 1st hit of a normal attack combo: Class changes to Defender(s).
When you start capturing Treasure: Class changes to Runner(s).
When dealing damage with a Normal Attack, 100% chance to: ???
Every time you continually recover the Treasure Gauge by 10% when you are in your team's Treasure Area: ???
Every time you continually lower the enemy's Treasure Gauge by 10%: ???
When Respawned: ???
After KOing an enemy, ???
When attacking a character type "Celestial Dragons / Former Celestial Dragons" enemy: Nullify the Trait "Recover HP when enough damage is taken to KO character".
After KOing an enemy, Recover HP by 50%.
Recovers the Treasure Gauge 50% past its maximum amount. and Can ignore the enemy and refill the Treasure Gauge.
When attacked by an enemy using a skill: Remove enemy's ATK increase. and Recover HP by 3%.
When your allies are not near the Treasure area where you are at: Boost capture speed by 50%. and Reduce damage received by 30%.
When your team has less Treasure secured: Boost capture speed by 30%.
When attacking an enemy, 100% chance to: Increase ATK by 3% (increases up to 70% but resets once KO'd). and Increase DEF by 3% (increases up to 70% but resets once KO'd).

After receiving damage from an enemy which is less than or equal to 20% of your max HP: resist Stagger. and After holding down the skill button during the 1st hit of a normal attack combo: The 2nd hit of the attack changes into a counter attack that knocks enemies back. (Become temporarily invincible.) When counter succeeds: Recover HP by 30%.
Reduces the effect time of status effects inflicted by enemies by 80%. and Reduce the damage received from enemy skills by 50%.
For a set period of time after using a skill: Resist Stagger, being Downed, and Knockback. and Removes current parameter reductions and nullifies incoming parameter reductions.
When attacked by an enemy with the Element you are strong against: Remove enemy's ATK increase.
When attacked by a character type "Celestial Dragons / Former Celestial Dragons" enemy: Remove enemy's DEF increase.

skill_names: Gum-Gum Dawn Balloon & Super-Size Nika Punch
limitations: Pesos e fatores são heurísticos, não oficiais nem medidos em partidas.
Não simula dano final, evolução de skills, mapas, inimigos, troca de classe ou todos os traits.
Traits adicionais não estão equipados neste ranking. Recomendações de atributos são separadas.
Condições usam os fatores gerais 0,5 e 0,25; o cenário real pode mudar a ordem.
Os três primeiros podem compartilhar medalhas: não se força diversidade à custa da pontuação.
